mapper.sql: l.log_id AS logId, l.log_no AS logNo, l.business_type AS businessType, l.action_type AS actionType, l.operator_type AS operatorType, l.operator_id AS operatorId, l.operator_name AS operatorName, l.source_ip AS sourceIp, l.target_type AS targetType, l.target_id AS targetId, l.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, l.ticket_id AS ticketId, t.ticket_no AS ticketNo, p.title AS projectTitle, l.before_status AS beforeStatus, l.after_status AS afterStatus, l.result_status AS resultStatus, l.action_description AS actionDescription, l.detail_json AS detailJson, l.create_time AS createTime

FROM ticket_operation_log l LEFT JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id = l.order_id LEFT JOIN electronic_ticket t ON t.ticket_id = l.ticket_id LEFT JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = o.project_id

where.if: AND ( l.log_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.action_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.operator_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.ticket_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_operation_log (log_no, business_type, action_type, operator_type, operator_id, operator_name, source_ip, target_type, target_id, order_id, ticket_id, before_status, after_status, result_status, action_description, detail_json, create_time) VALUES (#{logNo}, #{businessType}, #{actionType}, #{operatorType}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{sourceIp}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{orderId}, #{ticketId}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{resultStatus}, #{actionDescription}, #{detailJson}, #{createTime})
